sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose between imperfective and perfective past forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите между несовершенным и совершенным видом в прошедшем времени

items.prompt: Он _____ эту книгу за два дня. (He read this book in two days.) - completed in a time frame
items.promptEnglish: He read this book in two days. (finished)
items.hint: За два дня (in two days) = completed within a timeframe = perfective.
items.explanation: За + time = completed within that period. Perfective: прочитал.

items.prompt: Она _____ суп два часа. (She cooked soup for two hours.) - duration
items.promptEnglish: She cooked soup for two hours. (process over time)
items.hint: Два часа as duration (how long?) = imperfective.
items.explanation: Two hours of cooking = duration/process. Imperfective: варила.

items.prompt: Когда я _____, зазвонил телефон. (While I was working, the phone rang.)
items.promptEnglish: While I was working, the phone rang.
items.explanation: Background ongoing action = imperfective: работал. The phone ringing interrupts.

items.prompt: Мы _____ и пошли домой. (We ate and went home.) - sequential completed actions
items.promptEnglish: We ate and went home. (one after the other)
items.hint: Sequential completed actions (ate, then went) = perfective.
items.explanation: Sequential completed events: поели (finished eating), then пошли. Both perfective.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ пирог два часа. (She baked a pie for two hours.) - how long?
minimalPairs.explanation: Два часа (how long?) = duration = imperfective: пекла.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ пирог за два часа. (She baked a pie in two hours.) - completed within
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She baked a pie in two hours. (finished within that time)
minimalPairs.explanation: За два часа (within two hours) = completed. Perfective: испекла.

minimalPairs.context: Он вчера _____ письмо. (He was writing a letter yesterday.) - process
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He was writing a letter yesterday. (no mention of finishing)
minimalPairs.explanation: No mention of finishing = focus on the process. Imperfective: писал.

minimalPairs.context: Он вчера _____ письмо и отправил его. (He wrote a letter yesterday and sent it.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He wrote a letter and sent it. (finished, then sent)
minimalPairs.explanation: Wrote AND sent = two sequential completed actions. Perfective: написал.

blanks: Дети весь день _____ в парке. (The children played in the park all day.)
Он _____ домашнее задание и пошёл гулять. (He did his homework and went for a walk.)
Раньше мы часто _____ в этот ресторан. (We used to go to this restaurant often.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Aspect choice in past tense based on context
hints: Весь день = all day = duration = imperfective.
explanations: Sequential completed actions. Perfective: сделал (then пошёл).
Часто + раньше = habitual past. Imperfective: ходили.

sets.title: Time Signal Clues
sets.description: Match time expressions to the correct aspect
sets.descriptionRussian: Соотнесите выражения времени с правильным видом глагола

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: does this time expression signal imperfective or perfective?

errorCorrection.explanation: Долго (for a long time) = process. Imperfective: решали, not решили.

errorCorrection.hint: Каждое утро = every morning = habitual = imperfective.
Вдруг = suddenly = single instant event = perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Вдруг (suddenly) = single completed moment. Perfective: вспомнил.

items.prompt: Она _____ всю ночь. (She studied all night.) - duration
items.explanation: Всю ночь = duration = imperfective: учила (was studying).

items.prompt: Мальчик _____ и упал. (The boy ran and fell.) - sequence
items.promptEnglish: The boy ran and fell. (two quick events)
items.explanation: Ran (started running) and fell = sequential perfective: побежал.

items.prompt: В детстве я каждый день _____ на велосипеде. (As a child, I rode a bicycle every day.)
items.promptEnglish: As a child, I rode my bicycle every day.
items.explanation: Каждый день (every day) in childhood = habitual. Imperfective: катался.

sets.title: За vs Duration
sets.description: Distinguish 'for two hours' (duration) from 'in two hours' (completion)

patternRecognition.sentence: Он читал книгу два часа. vs. Он прочитал книгу за два часа.
patternRecognition.question: What is the key difference between these sentences?
options: 'Два часа' = how long (process); 'за два часа' = within that time (completed)
patternRecognition.answer: 'Два часа' = how long (process); 'за два часа' = within that time (completed)
patternRecognition.explanation: Without за: duration (how long the process lasted). With за: completed within that timeframe.

patternRecognition.sentence: Когда я читал, он позвонил. (While I was reading, he called.)
patternRecognition.question: Why are two different aspects used in the same sentence?
options: Background action (imperfective) interrupted by a sudden event (perfective)
patternRecognition.answer: Background action (imperfective) interrupted by a sudden event (perfective)
patternRecognition.explanation: Russian uses imperfective for the background action and perfective for the interrupting event.

items.prompt: Она _____ торт три часа. (She baked a cake for three hours.)
items.promptEnglish: She baked a cake for three hours. (how long)
items.explanation: Three hours without за = duration. Imperfective: пекла.

items.prompt: Она _____ торт за три часа. (She baked a cake in three hours.)
items.promptEnglish: She baked a cake in three hours. (finished within)
items.hint: За три часа = completed within = perfective.
items.explanation: За + time = completed within. Perfective: испекла.

items.prompt: Когда мы _____, начался дождь. (While we were walking, it started to rain.)
items.promptEnglish: While we were walking, it started to rain.
items.explanation: Background ongoing action: гуляли (imperfective). Rain starting = perfective начался.

blanks: Студент _____ контрольную работу за сорок минут. (The student finished the test in 40 minutes.)
Мы _____ в этом доме пять лет. (We lived in this house for five years.)
Когда я _____, пришёл друг. (While I was cooking, a friend came.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: За + time (perfective) vs bare duration (imperfective) vs background action
hints: За сорок минут = completed within = perfective.
explanations: Five years without за = duration. Imperfective: жили.

sets.title: Action Chains
sets.description: Practice sequential and background actions in past tense

items.prompt: Она _____ и села. (She entered and sat down.) - two quick sequential actions
items.hint: Two sequential completed actions = both perfective.
items.explanation: Sequential completed actions: вошла (perfective) и села (perfective).

items.prompt: Пока мама _____, дети играли. (While mom was cooking, the children played.)
items.promptEnglish: While mom was cooking, the children played.
items.explanation: Пока (while) = two simultaneous ongoing actions = both imperfective: готовила, играли.

items.prompt: Он _____ кофе, _____ газету и пошёл на работу. (He drank coffee, read the paper, and went to work.)
items.promptEnglish: He drank coffee, read the newspaper, and went to work.
items.hint: Three sequential completed actions = all perfective.
items.explanation: A chain of completed actions: выпил, прочитал, пошёл. All perfective.

translation.english: While I was sleeping, he left.
She cooked dinner and called us.
translation.answer: Она приготовила ужин и позвала нас.

translation.english: He studied Russian for three years.
translation.answer: Он учил русский язык три года.
acceptableVariants: Он изучал русский язык три года.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ ужин, когда я пришёл. (She was cooking dinner when I arrived.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She was cooking when I arrived. (background)
minimalPairs.explanation: Background action in progress when something happened = imperfective: готовила.

minimalPairs.context: Она уже _____ ужин, когда я пришёл. (She had already cooked dinner when I arrived.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She had already cooked dinner when I arrived. (completed before)
minimalPairs.explanation: Уже (already) = completed before arrival. Perfective: приготовила.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A comprehensive final round on past tense aspect

items.prompt: Мы _____ песни и танцевали всю ночь. (We sang songs and danced all night.) - two simultaneous ongoing actions
items.promptEnglish: We sang and danced all night.
items.hint: Всю ночь = all night = duration. Two ongoing activities = imperfective.
items.explanation: Всю ночь = duration. Simultaneous ongoing activities = imperfective: пели, танцевали.

items.prompt: Он _____ дверь и вышел. (He opened the door and went out.) - sequence
items.promptEnglish: He opened the door and went out.
items.explanation: Opened (completed) then went out = sequential perfective: открыл.

items.prompt: В прошлом году я _____ в Москве. (Last year I lived in Moscow.) - general past fact
items.promptEnglish: Last year I lived in Moscow.
items.hint: General statement about the past = imperfective.
items.explanation: General fact about a period of time = imperfective: жил.

items.prompt: Она _____ все задания за полчаса. (She completed all tasks in half an hour.)
items.promptEnglish: She completed all tasks in half an hour.
items.hint: За полчаса (in half an hour) = completed within = perfective.
items.explanation: За + time = completed within. Perfective: выполнила.

errorCorrection.sentence: Когда я читал книгу, я прочитал сто страниц.
errorCorrection.hint: If you read 100 pages (quantified result), both verbs should be perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Reading 100 pages is a quantified result, not process. Should be: Я прочитал сто страниц.

errorCorrection.sentence: Он пришёл домой и готовил ужин.
errorCorrection.hint: Came home AND cooked = two sequential completed actions.
errorCorrection.explanation: Sequential completed actions: пришёл (perfective) and приготовил (perfective).
